title: Vendor Analytics
description: In Analyze Tasks, click New analysis task to configure and run; results appear in Data preview for review and push.
noPreviewData: Nothing to preview yet. Create an analysis or load results from the task queue.
snapshotPushHint: Confirm data below, then preview or push to {{count}} enabled vendor Feishu groups.
previewSnapshotTooltipNoAi: Preview snapshot landing page (AI summary off)
noStationWarning: No responsibility station selected — metrics aggregate all stations.
loadJobFirst: Load a task from the queue via View data first
enablePushVendors: Enable vendors to push in New analysis task first
pushAfterScreenshot: Screenshot and push to enabled vendor Feishu groups
dailyReportFailed: Daily report publish failed — external share links not updated: {{error}}
drawerFooter: Will analyze {{stations}} stations · push to {{vendors}} vendors
selectStationTop: Select responsibility station in the header first
noStationDrawer: No responsibility station selected. Choose stations in the global filter before starting.
referenceDateDesc: Treated as "today" to derive yesterday/day-before for real-time metrics.
complaintRangeDesc: Time range for complaint rate and pickup volume.
metricConfigDesc: Select metrics to fetch and display. All selected by default.
dateSensitiveWarning: Reference date is in the past — {{labels}} may be inaccurate due to return-trip data backfill.
noSupplierConfig: No vendor configs — maintain them under System → Supplier config.
driverPerformanceHint: Pickup (yesterday) · 24H dispatch (day before) · Return alert (48h+ since 14:00) · Long-tail
metricSelectionHint: Metric and module choices apply when you click Start analysis.
editJobIntro: Edit push vendor scope and extension modules. AI summary affects display/push only — no re-run needed. Driver map requires re-analysis if not captured. Vendor/driver metric sets are fixed — create a new task to change them.
moduleSaveHint: AI summary applies immediately; driver map needs sync at analysis time. Republish snapshot/daily report to update external share links.
shareIntro: One external link per enabled push vendor (no login, token access, 7-day TTL). Links auto-open when publishing daily report from Data preview.
shareEmpty: No share links yet. Open Data preview, publish via Preview snapshot / Capture & push, then manage links here.
shareResetConfirm: Reset share link? Old links stop working immediately.
editJobTooltip: Edit push scope and AI summary
shareJobTooltip: Manage external share links for this task
previewHint: Confirm data, then Capture & push to Feishu above
noStationPreviewWarning: No station selected — complaint volume uses all stations; push still filters by selected stations
sharedCodeTooltip: Multiple vendors share vendor code {{code}} (split by route). Complaints and open tickets have no route — totals show combined code values. Pickup, before-11 exit, and 24H dispatch are split by route.
rankingNeedTwo: Composite ranking needs at least 2 vendors selected
rankingWeightHint: Default weights: {{weights}}. Counts normalized per 1k parcels; exit/dispatch denominators <30 and complaint window <500 excluded from weighting.
breakdownTitle: Component contribution (weights re-normalized to enabled metrics)

toast.loadedJobDifferentStations: Loaded task data (stations: {{stations}} — differs from current selection, metrics re-filtered)
